What is System Design?: storyboard

Episode 1 · voice Liam · 11 scenes · 85.2s (measured timing) · one still per beat, 8 frames after it fires

hook hook Hook · 0.0s–4.1s

Headline: Millions. At once.

“How does Netflix survive millions of people hitting play at once?”

branding sting 4.1s–5.6s

Bite wipe → logos → cut. No voiceover, just the chomp.

idea idea Analogy · 5.6s–12.4s

Headline: Apps are cities

“The answer is system design: planning your app like a city, before a single person moves in.”

breakdown versus Split · 12.4s–22.0s

Headline: Code vs. city plan

“Coding builds one building. System design plans the whole city: the roads, the power, and what happens when it floods.”

breakdown questions ThreeCards · 22.0s–29.9s

No headline

“Say we're designing Instagram. First, questions: how many users? How fast must photos load? Can it go down?”

breakdown boxes FlowDiagram · 29.9s–39.5s

Headline: Boxes and arrows

“Then the boxes. Phones hit a load balancer, which spreads them across servers. Photos land in storage, with a cache up front.”

breakdown hot FlowDiagram · 39.5s–45.9s

No headline

“The cache keeps hot photos close, so one viral post doesn't hammer storage a million times over.”

breakdown crash FlowDiagram · 45.9s–52.9s

Headline: Crash? No problem

“And if a server crashes? The load balancer stops sending it traffic, and users never even notice.”

breakdown tradeoff Tiers · 52.9s–62.2s

Headline: Cheap, fast or safe?

“Every choice costs something. One server: cheap, but fragile. Copies in every region: fast and safe, but pricey.”

breakdown interview Sequence · 62.2s–73.3s

Headline: The real test

“That's why interviews say: design Instagram. Great answers ask first: how many users? A billion? Then boxes and trade-offs.”

breakdown bigpicture BigPicture · 73.3s–79.4s

No headline

“So put it together: ask first, sketch the boxes, plan for crashes, then pick your trade-off.”

gist gist GistCard · 79.4s–85.2s

No headline

“That's the gist: design so growth doesn't break you. Follow for more.”
